assets.name: wood_top_locked
assets.description: The exact same forked driftwood from the reference viewed in STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP PLAN. Camera points VERTICALLY DOWN, elevation EXACTLY 90 degrees. Reveal the entire FRONT-BACK spread of stabilizing roots and the upper sides of the knotted root crotch. Tall upward fork must be strongly foreshortened into a short stub extending toward camera rather than towering above the main trunk. Keep master left-right orientation with knotted base LEFT and long sinuous main limb reaching RIGHT. This object is about twice as long as its front-back spread. Preserve source branch inventory and continuous natural grain. This must be a real camera rotation, not a copied broadside pose. White studio background, entire silhouette and margins, no scene, text or cast shadow.
